name: rust-isolation-preserved
body: Nested-module discovery must not disturb the build isolation: src/rustlib must NOT be made a member of the root workspace. Its isolation — separate Cargo.lock, isolated src/rustlib/target/, pinned rust-analyzer git dependencies, edition = "2021" — is deliberate and load-bearing per build.rs (the rustlib build block). The fix is discovery, never workspace membership. AC: the root Cargo.toml workspace membership is unchanged; src/rustlib still builds into its own target dir with its own lockfile.
